text:
aya: quick report — onboarding bulk-warmup sample crashes into 429s then retry storms when users set batch=64 + concurrency=10. Repro on node SDK.

mike: do you have a short trace? token vs concurrent caps?

aya: concurrency. We fire 10 parallel POSTs, edge responds with Retry-After ~2s, and then retries bunch up and cause a second wave.

jules: node SDK currently ignores Retry-After for bulkCreate and uses low-jitter exp backoff. That will sync retries.

aya: sample config we ship:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, maxConcurrency: 10 });
await client.embeddings.bulkCreate({ inputs, batchSize: 64 });
```

infra-bot: created DX-3001 "bulk warmup: retry storms + parity" assigned @mike

mike: plan: (1) SDK: honor Retry-After (seconds + HTTP-date) for bulk endpoints, (2) switch to full jittered backoff for bulk, (3) semaphore should account for estimateTokens(batch) when acquiring slots, (4) sample: lower onboarding defaults to concurrency=3, batch=24 and add RW_ONBOARD_FAST opt-in.

tara: also add an e2e test with a fake rate-limit proxy that returns Retry-After so we assert retries are spread.

jules: parity follow-up: iOS/Go/Android must implement same semantics. I'll add checklist to DX-3001.

aya: quick mitigation in sample: set concurrency=2 and add a small sleep between page enqueues. Works locally. If people repro, run with DEBUG=sdk:throttle and include the X-RW-SLOTS header. :thumbsup:
